literal_meaning: বস্তু বা বস্তুর প্রতি নিষ্ঠা (devotion to the object or fact)
figurative_meaning_en: Fidelity to the actual state or objectivity
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বিবরণ বস্তুনিষ্ঠ ছিল, কোনো অতিরঞ্জিত কথা ছিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: His description was objective, without any exaggeration.
Objectivity is extremely important in journalism.
note: This is a compound adjective rather than a traditional proverbial idiom, commonly used in modern Bengali for emphasizing factual accuracy.
